newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada dollar closes stronger in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Canada dollar closes stronger in quiet trade.

text.p: * Canada's dollar ended stronger on Tuesday to close at C$1.3365 (US$0.7483) from Monday's close at C$1.3385 (US$0.7471) in quiet trading, dealers said.* They said the currency gained most of its strength in afternoon trading, taking its cue from the U.S. dollar. * Comments from U.S. Fed Chairman Alan Greenspan had little impact.
Comments from U.S. Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan and U.S. Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin on Tuesday had little effect on Canadian dollar, dealers said.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar rose to 1.2185 marks from 1.2147 marks on Monday and edged up to 88.18 yen from 88.14 yen.
